name: blender chatgpt python script create gold ball
goal: Use ChatGPT to generate a Blender Python script, paste it in the Scripting workspace, and run it to create a material-previewable object.

source.title: Blender Tutorial – How to Use AI to Create 3D Models (ChatGPT and Blender)

prerequisites: Basic familiarity with Blender UI helps prompting

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Ask ChatGPT to write a Blender script (must say script)

outputs.name: generated_object
outputs.description: Object created by running the script (e.g. gold ball)

constraints: Prompt must request a script or ChatGPT may return manual steps instead
Scripts may fail on newer Blender APIs; paste error text back to ChatGPT to iterate
Complex prompts often fail on free GPT-3.5; simpler prompts work more reliably

steps.action: Install/launch Blender from blender.org; dismiss splash.
Open chat.openai.com; prompt e.g. write a Blender script that creates a gold ball (include the word script).
Copy the code block from ChatGPT.
In Blender, select default cube, press X and confirm delete for a blank start.
Open Scripting workspace tab → New → paste (Ctrl/Cmd+V).
Click Run; switch back to Layout; enable Material Preview shading to see material color.
If the script errors, copy the error into ChatGPT and retry with the fixed script.

verification: Material Preview shows non-default look if material was assigned
